caption: The drawing depicts a richly decorated room filled with numerous ornate objects. The walls are vertically striped in green and tan, accented with pink and yellow garlands near the ceiling, which has a detailed molding. The floor is covered with a deep red carpet and a colorful, patterned rug. In the foreground, there is a round table with curved, cream-colored legs and a floral decoration on top; books and other small objects sit below. Two blue velvet chairs with gold and blue fringe, and a brown patterned throw draped over one, are positioned nearby. A large, pink-and-gold fringed lamp stands to the left, next to a blue upholstered chair and potted plant. Behind the table, there is an elaborate easel holding a framed portrait of a woman. To the right is a side table draped in blue and gold fabric, with various items including candlesticks, a dark vase, and small objects. Above this, a wall niche is draped with gold and blue curtains, displaying a white statue. Another ornate, cream-colored table holds a blue and white porcelain vase and a seashell. A large green curtain with gold trim and lace drapes over a window at the back left, next to which hangs a model ship in a glass case on the wall. The ceiling holds an elaborate glass chandelier, and a small guitar rests on a blue chair in the left background. Overall, the drawing is composed of rich blues, golds, creams, reds, pinks, and green hues, with many textures and patterns evident throughout the room.
title: Boudoir
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
